title: Use federated identity with a third-party service: decision comparison 1
teachingQuestion: When may a relying party trust an external assertion/token?
focalInsight: Validate issuer, audience, subject, time, signature/key, nonce/state and authorization mapping.
caption: Compare meaning, decision conditions, and failures. These concise distinctions are paired with the worked examples in the teaching unit.

nodes.label: Relying Party
nodes.definition: A service that relies on an external identity provider’s assertion to establish information about a subject.
nodes.decision: Validate issuer, signature/key, audience, time and replay protections, then map the subject to local permissions.
nodes.failureExample: A validly signed token intended for another service is accepted without checking its audience.
nodes.detail: A service that relies on an external identity provider’s assertion to establish information about a subject.
